# sfcompute_workspace (Resource)

Manages an SF Compute workspace (created with `POST /v2/workspaces`, updated in place with `PATCH /v2/workspaces/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sfcompute_workspace" "research" {
  name = "research"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) Workspace ID or resource path
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a workspace resource. Format: sfc:workspace:<account>:<name>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID or resource path.
terraform import sfcompute_workspace.research wksp_k3RnX9vLm7Qp2Yw5Jd8F
```
